messages.text:
🚌 Bus information for Moonfest!

We'll depart at 11:00 AM from the Carulla on 116 and Autopista Norte (Carulla Alhambra, one block west of the Pepe Sierra Transmilenio station).

📍 Maps location: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Y9U7LxBPtwGxKn5u9

⚠️ Don't forget to fill out this form before July 5th! Whoever doesn't fill it out won't have a spot on the bus: https://forms.gle/UY4AaftqE4gawyrh9

The translation is straightforward—no skill needed for a direct text translation.

⚠️ IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT

To organize the transportation logistics and determine how many buses and how many spots we need to reserve, we need to know the exact number of attendees who will require these services.

For this reason, everyone who is going to attend must fill out this form BEFORE JULY 5, regardless of how they plan to get there. This applies to those traveling in their own transportation, those riding in someone else's car, and especially those planning to use the bus.

❗️If you plan to use the event bus and you are not registered on this list, we will not be able to guarantee you a spot that day, so please fill it out in advance.

👉 https://forms.gle/UY4AaftqE4gawyrh9

If you have any questions, contact an admin.

We share with you the dress code for Furry Moonfest 2026, which was developed in accordance with the guidelines set out by the Hotel ESTELAR Paipa & Convention Center.

We remind you that, although we will be occupying a large percentage of the hotel, there will be other guests not associated with the event, so we ask for your utmost cooperation in this regard.

🌙

Translation:

Good news! 

We made a bit more merch, so the option to pay for the ticket with merch included is available again, while supplies last.

If you were waiting for this opportunity, it's now!

🌙

We've been asked about the size of the space for the personal sticker on the passport credentials page: it is 6 x 6.5 cm.

You can start preparing yours!

🌙

Attention, Moonfest travelers!

Those who bought merch will receive their Moonfest passport, which will have a collection page with spaces to fill during the event.

So if you're going to print stickers to share, consider making some 2.6 x 2.5 cm with your character so people can stick them in their passport.

A stamp or anything else you can imagine also works to leave your mark on other people's passports. There's no single way to do it!

🌙

Today is the last day!

Today is the deadline to pay for the ticket with merch included. After today, tickets will still be available, but without merch.

🎟️ Payments via Nequi or Bre-B 👉 https://store.furrycolombia.com/
🎟️ Payments for foreigners or by card 👉 https://conspace.app/events/moonfest

------------------------

Also, today is the last day to register activities, panels, and to be part of the dealer's den!

📋  https://forms.gle/3ZQSLb52dtfn11ek9

We will be contacting the people who submitted their proposals starting Tuesday.

🌙

!REMINDER FOR ARTISTS AND PANELISTS! 

Until this Sunday, June 7, applications for activities and the Dealer’s Den will remain open.

If you have a panel, workshop, activity, or want to sell merchandise, remember to register by filling out the following form:
👉 https://forms.gle/3ZQSLb52dtfn11ek9

✨ Participation is completely free.

Only 5 days left to pay for your ticket with merch included!

The deadline closes on Sunday, June 7.

For payments with Nequi or Bre-B 👉 https://store.furrycolombia.com/
For card or international payments 👉 https://conspace.app/events/moonfest 

Don't miss out on your merch!

⚠️ Remember that the ticket is required to enter the event.

We extended the payment deadline!

Many of you asked us for more time, and we listened. You now have until Sunday, June 7 to pay for your ticket. If you pay before that date, the ticket includes the event merch.

⚠️ Remember that the ticket is required to participate in the event. No ticket, no entry.

If you have any questions, don’t hesitate to write to us
🌙

ATTENTION MOONFEST!

Do you want to host a panel? An activity? Sell things in the Dealer's Den?

Tell us your idea by filling out this form
👉 https://forms.gle/3ZQSLb52dtfn11ek9

But remember, YOU ONLY HAVE UNTIL JUNE 7.

Do you have questions? Message @NachoJukumari.

Don't leave it until the last minute!
🌙

Hi everyone! 🐾

Several of you have written to us mentioning that you won't be able to make your payment before May 29, but that you do want your merch.

The deadline will not be extended, however, we are willing to make an exception. If you confirm your intention to pay before that date, we will include you in the count so as not to leave you out of the order.

Keep in mind that once the order is closed there will be no way to add more units, so if you're interested, write to us before the 29.

⚠️ REMEMBER: THE TICKET IS MANDATORY TO PARTICIPATE IN THE ACTIVITIES. HAVING ONLY THE HOTEL RESERVATION IS NOT ENOUGH.

Hello everyone!

We're sharing some important information: the hotel is now completely full.

⚠️ IF ANY OF YOU ARE THINKING OF CANCELLING YOUR ROOM, PLEASE LET US KNOW BEFORE DOING SO.

This way we can transfer it to whoever needs it most within the group and avoid losing the spot.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation!

20 DAYS left to get the COMPLETE ticket!

Remember that only until May 29th can you buy your all-inclusive entry: merch, Moonfest admission, and transportation in one package.

After the 29th only the ticket with transportation will be available, so if you want the merch, this is your moment!

Don't leave it for later. Time is running out!

Payments via Nequi or Bre-B 👉 https://store.furrycolombia.com/store/es/products/0ac90670-ea99-4a25-9bb5-18605394f771/moonfest-2026-entrada-al-evento

Payments for foreigners or by card 👉 https://conspace.app/events/moonfest

We're opening registrations to participate in our programming!

If you have an activity, panel, workshop, presentation, or want to sell your products at the artist market, this is the moment.

Find all the information and the form at the link
👉 https://forms.gle/3ZQSLb52dtfn11ek9

Registration deadline: Sunday, June 7, 2026

Registration and participation in these activities is free of charge.

⚠️ Important notes:

About the official Furry Moonfest merch: Due to production timelines, the official kit is exclusive to payments made by May 29, 2026. After this date, registration will only include transportation and full access to all activities.

About new features on the website: You can now explore the new features on our site! As this is a beta version, your help is vital. If you find any bugs or have suggestions, please report them in the technical support channel we've opened in the official Moonfest group (👉 https://t.me/FurryMoonfest).

The suitcases are already packed. The route has already been mapped out. You already know the destination.

All that's missing is your ticket.

Furry Moonfest — tickets now open.
🌙

👉 https://moonfest.furrycolombia.com/?section=registration

Important clarifications about costs and registration

We know that in previous editions the payment process was different, but this year Furry Moonfest takes a step forward. With the goal of professionalizing the event and aligning ourselves with the reservation and registration methodology used in other conventions around the world, we have separated the accommodation and registration processes. So here we explain again how the process works:

Step 1: Hotel Reservation. It is independent of event registration. The room cost is split among those sharing it and includes breakfast and use of the hotel facilities.

Step 2: Event Ticket. Once you have your spot in a room with a confirmed reservation, you can purchase your ticket through the website once registrations open. This ticket costs 300,000 pesos (around 80 dollars) and includes:

· Official merch package.
· Access to all parties, panels, and the artist market.
· Round-trip transportation from Bogotá.
· And many more surprises!

If you have any questions about this topic, don't hesitate to write to us.

You can now visit our official website!

There you will find all the event information, you can reserve your room, and soon you will be able to buy your ticket for Furry Moonfest 2026.

👉 https://moonfest.furrycolombia.com/

Want to connect with other attendees?

Join our official Telegram group to find a roomie, sign up for activities, and chat with the community.

👉 https://t.me/FurryMoonfest

🎨: Nell Demon

Rules:

1. This is an SFW group—please do not post suggestive content.

2. No drama, no politics, no harassment; please be respectful of all attendees.

3. This group includes people who speak Spanish or English; please be respectful and understanding of those who do not speak the language.

4. If you have any questions, issues, or requests regarding the event or the group, please send a DM to the admins: Howl, Lucia, Nacho, Nax, and Nell.

This channel will be used to share all information related to Furry Moonfest.

Any message that does not correspond to this topic will be immediately deleted.
